title: pm daily scratchpad - launch week (optimize) 2026-03-06
content:
2026-03-06 PM scratchpad - Optimize launch week

Quick context:
- Goal: ship Optimize v1 with autosuggest batching + quantization recommendations behind feature flag for beta customers.
- Launch checkpoint: internal beta on 3/10, external pilot 3/17.
- Primary stakeholders: Evan (infra), Priya (eng - serving runtime), Tom (SRE), Sarah (sales eng), legal review in flight.

Morning priorities (top-down):
1) PRD final edits -> merge:
   - Finish section on rollout policy (canary pct + fallback conditions). TODO: add exact metrics for canary (p95 < 120ms, error rate < 1%). (owner: Maya)
   - Add note re: telemetry fields (cost_estimate_per_token, batch_size, fallback_model). (owner: Priya)
   - Confirm privacy blurb for pilot customers (legal). (owner: Maya -> @Legal)

2) Stakeholder follow-ups:
   - Evan: confirm dedicated pool sizing for beta (answer needed by EOD). Follow-up: ask for qps baseline from sales. (pinged 9:15am)
   - Tom: run blast test on canary routing config (blocked by infra tag RWD-3490).
   - Sarah: compile list of pilot customers who agreed to opt-in; need contact + expected qps. (Sarah to send today)

3) Launch checklist (short):
   - [ ] PRD merged + shared link
   - [ ] Feature flag toggles created (dev, staging, prod)
   - [ ] Telemetry dashboard (cost + quality) created in Grafana
   - [ ] Canary rollout policy docs in Console (how to rollback)
   - [ ] Customer comms draft (onboarding + opt-in)
   - [ ] Legal sign-off on data handling
   - [ ] Runbook + on-call rota for first 72h

Notes / rough copy for PRD section (cut/paste candidate):
- Rollout policy: Start canary at 1% of traffic for 2 hours, verify p95 latency and error rate, increase to 10% for 4 hours, then 50% for 6 hours before 100% if no regressions detected. Automatic rollback triggers: p95 increase > 20% vs baseline OR error rate > 1% OR cost per token spike > 2x expected.
- Metrics to monitor: p50/p95/p99 latency per model variant, errors by stack (serving/runtime/model), cost_per_token (estimated), batch size distribution, cache hit rate.

Open questions / blockers:
- Q1: Do we have a reliable cost_estimate per token for quantized variants? (Priya investigating)
- Q2: Can Dedicated customers enable the feature in private deployments? Need infra input on VPC alpha gating.
- Blocker: RWD-3490 (canary routing bug) must be triaged today or delays.

Meeting notes (standup 10:00am):
- Priya: landed basic telemetry schema; will add cost_estimate field by EOD.
- Evan: sizing estimate 2x baseline for safe reserve; wants clearer pilot qps to firm numbers.
- Tom: SRE will run synthetic canary at 5pm; needs feature-flagging config from dev.
- Action: Maya to update PRD with canary params and unblock flagged tickets.

Afternoon plan:
- 1pm: quick sync with Sarah to finalize pilot list (15m)
- 2pm: review customer comms draft, iterate with Marketing (send 80% draft by 4pm)
- 3pm: join infra triage for RWD-3490 (30-45m)
- 5pm: verify canary test results from Tom, capture screenshots/logs for postmortem

Reminders to self:
- Leave buffer for legal back-and-forth (usually 24-48h) -> prioritize sending final privacy blurb now.
- Keep PRD link shallow; owners should be able to grab sections and copy into Confluence.

Quick TODO (one-liners):
- [ ] Draft privacy blurb -> email legal (Maya)
- [ ] Add telemetry fields to PRD (Priya)
- [ ] Ask Sarah for pilot qps list (Maya)
- [ ] Create Grafana dashboard skeleton (Tom)
- [ ] Upload runbook template to shared drive (after 3pm)

Thoughts / rough brainstorming (freeform):
- Consider adding a short automation that detects model fallback and sends a Slack alert to #incidents + #product-optimize. Could reduce MTTD.
- If cost per token variance is high for quantized models, surface a recommendation in Console (e.g., "Quantized variant recommended for latency-sensitive, low-cost workflows").

End of day notes (to fill later):
- Capture canary metrics, note any customer feedback, update PRD with final rollout windows.

---
